grammar.summary: 本课继续条件句练习，加入电话场景的语法点。

points.title: if 条件句变体
points.explanation: 条件句主句也可用祈使句或情态动词：If he's not there, telephone me. / If you can, come early. 条件句不止 will 一种搭配。

examples.en: If you see him, tell him to call me.
examples.cn: 如果你见到他，让他给我打电话。

points.title: 电话场景的 this is 句型
points.explanation: 英式电话里自报家门用 This is Mary speaking.（不说 I am Mary），问对方 Is that you, John?
